run_preprocess: run the BasePreprocessing module to parallel-process 3D point cloud files and save databases
run_preprocess_sequential: run the BasePreprocessing module to sequentially process 3D point cloud files and save databases
run_make_instance_database: run the BasePreprocessing module to extract and save individual instances from a train database
run_extract_instance_from_file: run the BasePreprocessing module to extract labeled instances from a single processed point cloud file
run_joint_database: run the BasePreprocessing module to merge train and validation databases into a single joint database
